title: Gasparilla 2027 the Tampa's Ultimate Pirate Brunch and Bar Crawl
includes: Entry to Pirates Cove Crawl HQ and Dry Zone
Access to 25+ Bars across Downtown Tampa, SoHo and Ybor
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Age restricted event: 18+ for participation, and 21+ for bar and venues access.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a weekend filled with all-you-can-eat brunch, bottomless mimosas, free welcome shots, and exclusive drink specials as you explore over 25 bars and brunch venues. Experience the vibrant Pirates Cove festival featuring DJs, themed bars, and nonstop entertainment. With no set schedule, you can crawl at your own pace and immerse yourself in Tampa's most anticipated celebration.

- Kick off the adventure at 9 AM with check-in at your chosen venue
- Enjoy buffet-style brunch and bottomless mimosas from 9 AM to 12 PM (if applicable)
- Access two massive Pirates Cove festival zones with live entertainment
- Flexible crawling through 25+ participating bars across South Tampa and Ybor City
